About Us
At Topicus, we believe IT should serve society. From healthcare and education to finance, our solutions empower millions of people daily by turning complex challenges into user-friendly platforms. We don’t just build software; we increase self-reliance and reduce vulnerability for citizens worldwide.
With a team of over 1,800+ "Topicans" across Southeast Asia (Vietnam & Thailand) and Europe (the Netherlands, Romania, Portugal, and Iceland), we are constantly expanding our horizons. Our ambition reaches far beyond Europe, driven by a shared mission to make a meaningful difference.
 About the Role
We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer to build a next-generation AI-powered OCR platform for the financial industry. This solution processes large volumes of financial documents using modern machine learning and computer vision techniques to automate document recognition, extraction and validation.
The product is part of Akkuro, one of the leading composable banking platforms. Our Vietnam team will independently own and further develop this product, giving you significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence its future direction.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize AI-powered OCR solutions in Python.
Build and improve machine learning models for document recognition and data extraction.
Process and analyze large datasets using Pandas and related data processing libraries.
Train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models using TensorFlow or similar frameworks.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, testers, and software engineers.
Improve model accuracy, performance, and scalability.
Investigate new AI technologies and propose improvements to the product.
Take ownership of technical decisions and mentor other engineers.
